command:
overall=0
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
  echo "=== RUN $i ==="
  python3 deadlock_sim.py 2>&1 | tee deadlock_verify_run$i.log
  if grep -q "database is locked\|FAILED" deadlock_verify_run$i.log; then
    echo ">>> RUN $i: LOCK ERROR PRESENT"; overall=1
  else
    echo ">>> RUN $i: CLEAN, no lock errors"
  fi
  echo
done
echo "OVERALL: $([ $overall -eq 0 ] && echo 'ALL RUNS CLEAN' || echo 'LOCK ERRORS OCCURRED')"
intent: Run simulation 5 times and grep for lock errors
